content:
A photo from a walk on 2026-03-21.  
📷 OM-3 & 75 mm ƒ1.8

photos.alt: A photo of a wide path in a forest between the trees, with a dozen or so of people further along it walking. The trees are tall and mostly leafless, although with a few early greenery starting to appear, and their branches almost form a canopy arc at the top, through which a bit of a clear sky can be seen. Closer to the horizon a clearing can be seen.
